title: `cond and a or b` in Luau returns b when a is nil, so a missing value shows the other side's
observation: A server sent each of two challenge players their own score and their opponent's with `mine = player == a and sa or sb` and `theirs = player == a and sb or sa`. When player a had no score (they did not finish) the first expression fell through to sb, and when b had none the second fell through to sa, so a player who did not finish was shown the opponent's time as their own, and a finisher was shown their own time as the opponent's. Nothing displayed the fields in the first release, so linting, builds and 136 tests all passed; a later screen that printed them made the bug visible, and a code review found it by reading the expression, not by running anything.
recommendation: Where the value in the middle of `cond and a or b` can legitimately be nil or false, write a plain `if` (or a tiny pure function) instead, and give it a test with a missing value on each side. Treat data sent to clients but not yet shown as untested.
applies_when: A Luau expression picks between two values with `and ... or ...`
One of the values can be nil or false, for example a score, a time or an optional record
limits: One occurrence in one Roblox game (October 2026)
Selene 0.32 and StyLua do not flag the pattern

evidence.detail: Section 5, item 1: found by review of src/server/Challenges.lua, replaced with PortGames.sides, and covered by a PortGamesSpec test (143 of 143 Luau tests passed).
